NAMING RULES — v1.1 Owner: Lucas Buzek

ENGLISH

1.  Preserve established canonical names. Do not casually rename a
    validated identity.
2.  A strong EDEN name should carry functional meaning, conceptual
    meaning and, where established, behavioral metaphor/personality.
3.  Do not force a backronym when it weakens the identity.
4.  Canonical display convention where appropriate: [ACRONYM] —
    [Expanded Functional Meaning] — v[VERSION] Version is
    release/package metadata and is not automatically part of identity.
5.  Distinguish: APP / PRODUCT / WORKSPACE / HELPER / AGENT / MODULE /
    CAPABILITY / PROVIDER / INSTANCE-CONNECTION / ORCHESTRATOR.
6.  Same display name does not prove same identity. Namespace internal
    identities: READ.THREAD, CASPER.THREAD, ORACLE.MODELLER, IRIS.FORGE,
    etc.
7.  Generic functions do not need artificial personalities.
8.  A package or prompt does not automatically make its subject a
    top-level App.
9.  A different AI model/provider does not create a new product
    identity.
10. Capability names should be provider-neutral where practical:
    translation, vision.analyze, reasoning.general, embeddings.text,
    etc.
11. Provider identities name implementations; connections identify
    configured accounts/devices/installations.
12. Preserve aliases and historical names as provenance.
13. Supersession must be explicit: UIbasic → SUPERSEDED BY → LCAS.
14. Do not silently merge duplicate names. Record relationships and
    confidence.
15. Unresolved identities remain UNRESOLVED; do not invent
    expansions/personas.
16. App reconciliation asks: What authoritative state does it own? Does
    another App already own it? Is it actually a
    Workspace/Helper/Module/Capability/Provider?
17. Products and physical systems remain distinct from their controlling
    Apps when that distinction is established.
18. File/package naming: root: [ACRONYM]_[Expanded_Name]_v[VERSION]/
    concise versioned internal filenames; human docs default TXT;
    code/config native.
19. Every package includes README.txt and a clear manifest/inventory
    where useful.
20. English is canonical/reference; EN/SK baseline applies to
    Custom/Private/ Experimental shipped documentation.

SLOVENSKY

1.  Zachovaj etablované kanonické názvy; validovanú identitu bez dôvodu
    nepremenúvaj.
2.  Silný EDEN názov nesie funkčný význam, konceptuálny význam a podľa
    potreby metaforu.
3.  Nevynucuj backronym, ak zhoršuje identitu.
4.  Vhodný formát: [AKRONYM] — [Rozšírený funkčný význam] — v[VERZIA].
5.  Rozlišuj APP / PRODUCT / WORKSPACE / HELPER / AGENT / MODULE /
    CAPABILITY / PROVIDER / INSTANCE-CONNECTION / ORCHESTRATOR.
6.  Rovnaký názov neznamená rovnakú identitu. Interné identity
    namespacuj.
7.  Generické funkcie nepotrebujú umelú osobnosť.
8.  Balík alebo prompt automaticky nevytvára top-level App.
9.  Iný AI model/provider nevytvára novú produktovú identitu.
10. Capability názvy majú byť podľa možnosti nezávislé od providera.
11. Provider je implementácia; connection je konkrétne nakonfigurované
    spojenie.
12. Historické názvy a aliasy zachovaj ako provenance.
13. Supersession musí byť explicitný: UIbasic → LCAS.
14. Duplicitné názvy automaticky nezlučuj.
15. Nejasná identita ostáva UNRESOLVED.
16. Pri App sa pýtaj, aký autoritatívny stav vlastní a či ho už
    nevlastní iná App.
17. Produkt/fyzický systém odlišuj od riadiacej aplikácie, ak je to
    etablované.
18. Root balíka: [ACRONYM]_[Expanded_Name]_v[VERSION]/.
19. Každý balík obsahuje README.txt.
20. Angličtina je referencia; Custom/Private/Experimental dokumentácia
    má EN/SK baseline.
